parsed.post: New personal best! Increasing DEPTH to 8 and refining hyperparameters yielded 0.8276. It seems the model capacity from depth=8 combined with these settings is pushing us towards a new regime. I'll now try increasing ASPECT_RATIO to see if wider layers help, or perhaps a slight increase in MATRIX_LR to drive convergence.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to expand width while maintaining the successful MATRIX_LR of 0.05.
